_about: How the chord finder ranks shapes (lower score = shown first). Each weight multiplies the quantity named. Change one number at a time and run scripts/check-vguitar.mjs.

_weights.positionFret: per fret of the lowest fretted note (prefer shapes near the nut / capo)
_weights.handCost: times the fingering awkwardness from hand.js
_weights.courseShape: a shape listed in fingerings.json uses this as its hand cost (then × handCost) — negative, so lesson shapes come first
_weights.openBetweenFrettedPastFret2: per open string ringing between fretted strings when the hand is at fret 2 or higher
_weights.openWithHighFret: per open string when the shape reaches fret 4 or higher, plus openWithHighFretPerFret per fret above 3
